verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no user-controllable data retention or deletion settings, such as account or personal data deletion, retention windows, or deletion of AI and MCP interaction data. The only retention mention is a fixed three-month retention of API usage counts, which users cannot control. Deleting DNS records and forwarding rules or revoking PATs are adjacent resource-management features, not data retention and deletion controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
